verdict.rationale: Bolna can be driven without its UI. There is a documented single-binary Go CLI for managing agents, calls, numbers and batches "directly from your terminal — no dashboard tab required." A REST API covers the full flow from API key to placed call and transcript, and multi-step workflows can be "driven entirely through the Bolna API," which together give the core of headless automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive/env-var auth for the CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found all paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
